summary: Owner request (2026-11-05, #1010): source and defend the two open bridges of WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE. Pinned and read: Dei Filius ch. 4 and canons IV (Latin, vatican.va), CIC 1983 cann. 747-755 and 1364-1369 (Latin, vatican.va; Book VI as revised 2021), Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.2-I.3 n.2 (Corpus Thomisticum), PU §373 (pinned German), SEP Fideism §3. (a) is supported by the practice's law of teaching (can. 749 §2), membership (cann. 750-751, 1364-1365), its self-description (Dei Filius ch. 4, can. IV.3 on the declared sense of dogma) and Wittgenstein's 'Theologie als Grammatik'; (b) by Dei Filius ch. 4 (two orders distinct in principle; God known by the gentiles) and SCG I.2-3 (natural reason to which all must assent, against pagans; the philosophers' proofs). The fideist replies are recorded at full strength as unattributed alternatives (conciliar teaching is theology, not grammar; natural reason within a theological horizon), with the supports they have (Phillips 2005, 75; Clayton and Taylor) and the texts against them as attacks. Rejected: recording either bridge as stated (no text states it; each source leaves a named gap) or the attacks as refutations (their premises are stated, not established). Logic-first follow-up for the Moorean candidate batch (#1119, 2026-11-06): the grammar-case vocabulary now exists (FIDEISM-GRAMMAR-CASES-PARTITION), so its absence is no longer the blocker. The exact original Challenge still has three unestablished inputs, including the stated CouncilDefinesNaturalKnowabilityReading, not only these two bridges. FideismFailsAsDescription is the negation of InternalGrammarReading ∧ CutOffReading; the recorded alternative to revelation is CutOffReading alone. No refutes relation targets that single rival. In-memory frontier settlement probes at main 0367eebc establish the bundle-failure result if all three inputs are hypothetically settled, but do not refute CutOffReading or lower any route. See docs/notes/moorean-floor-candidates.md for the ranked candidate batch, precise scopes and remaining registration/interpretation gaps.
